name: Another World
source:
The smallest independent country in the Atlantic Ocean, the Republic of Samaria. It's a peaceful city, but fire breaks out, gunfire is heard and people are evacuated from the streets. Something dreadful approaches and you're a part of public safety forces to oppose it...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大西洋上最小的独立国家——萨马里亚共和国。这座城市原本和平，却突然起火、响起枪声，人们纷纷撤离街道。一种可怕的东西正在逼近，而你是负责抵抗它的治安部队成员之一……

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndreview[/url]）
